messages.content: I need three unrelated facts, look each one up on the web: (a) the weather forecast for Lisbon tomorrow, (b) the current EUR to USD exchange rate, (c) the current LTS version of Node.js. Then also use the web fetch tool on https://example.com/ and tell me its title. One short line per item. End with a line: REPORT search_calls=<n> search_queries=<n> fetches=<n>.
